A combined cycle power plant has one gas turbine, a heat recovery steam generator and a steam turbine. It runs at full load. Hourly records give net electrical output (MW) together with ambient temperature (2 to 37 degC), ambient pressure, relative humidity and condenser vacuum. The plant has an inlet chiller in front of the compressor. In warm weather it cools the intake air down to a fixed set temperature. Over this ambient range the gas turbine stays below the rated limit of its generator. At 15 degC and 1013 mbar the gas turbine alone produces about 343 MW. The chiller set temperature is about 24 degC; the chiller runs whenever ambient temperature is above it.

Answer each item separately for this plant over the 2 to 37 degC ambient range. Give your best numerical estimates even if you are unsure. Reply with JSON only, in this form:
{"gt_generator_limit": {"reached_in_range": true or false, "gt_mw_at_15c": <MW>, "limit_mw": <MW>, "gt_mw_per_degc": <change of gas-turbine output per degC of ambient temperature, negative if output falls as temperature rises>},
